column1: # dir (glob ok, relative to workspace)<TAB>authority<TAB>prune (yes|keep, then -GLOB ...)<TAB>tables: NAME=GLOB[@compact] ... (globs relative to dir)
# First matching row owns a file. "keep" = upload but never delete locally (live work / code repos).
# "yes -GLOB": prunable, but files whose basename matches GLOB are never pruned (run state and configs a later run resumes from).
# "@compact": theory-invalid rows of that table keep only inputs, ids and rejection reason (exact; blob stays lossless). New commits only.
